title: Piri Reis map showing Antarctica

tellings.quote: It's like the map of Piri Race where you have the sort of uh tropical parts of Antarctica that are shown uh you know at the top.

plain: Michels says the Piri Reis map, an old map, shows parts of Antarctica as tropical, as if someone had mapped the continent before it was covered in ice. He brings this up himself, drawing on the writer Graham Hancock and pointing to a second old map, the Oronteus Finaeus map. If true, it would suggest a lost knowledge of the world far older than recorded history.
